name: Weaver-ant salt
summary: The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names muối kiến among the Kon Tum dishes featured at the city’s food festival in early 2023. A recipe was not printed there.
origin: The tourism authority’s festival article lists muối kiến with gỏi lá, cơm lam, grilled chicken, lá mì, and stream fish as dishes Kon Tum city chose to feature.
howToEat: A method, a salt weight, and a price were not printed on that article. Go Vietnam’s cơm lam article says yellow-ant salt with grilled chicken is a familiar Central Highlands pairing, and it ties the salt by name to the Đắk Lắk tube, not to a Kon Tum stall. Check on arrival.
where: Kon Tum city’s 2023 food festival, on the tourism authority’s article. A shop was not printed. Check on arrival.
